paragraphs.en: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, Muse, Gemini, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: Poteto 的 pstack 的 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Pi、OpenCode、Muse、Gemini 和 Prime Agent 版本。 将基于 Cursor 原语的严谨智能体工作流移植到其他框架中。

sents.en: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, Muse, Gemini, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack.
sents.zh: Poteto 的 pstack 的 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Pi、OpenCode、Muse、Gemini 和 Prime Agent 版本。

sents.en: Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
sents.zh: 将基于 Cursor 原语的严谨智能体工作流移植到其他框架中。

paragraphs.en: Lauren Tan's pstack is an opinionated Cursor skill stack that improves agent outcomes. This is a port for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, GitHub Copilot, Muse, and other agent harnesses. It tracks upstream and also carries named policy forks, each declared in tools/forks.json .
paragraphs.zh: Lauren Tan 的 pstack 是一套有明确主张的 Cursor 技能栈，用于提升智能体的产出效果。 这是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、GitHub Copilot、Muse 及其他智能体框架的移植版本。 它会跟进上游更新，同时维护多个具名策略分支，每个分支都在 tools/forks.json 中声明。

sents.en: Lauren Tan's pstack is an opinionated Cursor skill stack that improves agent outcomes.
sents.zh: Lauren Tan 的 pstack 是一套有明确主张的 Cursor 技能栈，用于提升智能体的产出效果。

sents.en: This is a port for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, GitHub Copilot, Muse, and other agent harnesses.
sents.zh: 这是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、GitHub Copilot、Muse 及其他智能体框架的移植版本。

sents.en: It tracks upstream and also carries named policy forks, each declared in tools/forks.json .
sents.zh: 它会跟进上游更新，同时维护多个具名策略分支，每个分支都在 tools/forks.json 中声明。

paragraphs.en: Tell poteto-mode your goal and it will invoke the correct workflow for the task. It keeps your code concise, simple and verified.
paragraphs.zh: 告诉 poteto-mode 你的目标，它将为该任务调用正确的工作流。 它能让你的代码保持简洁、简单且经过验证。

sents.en: Tell poteto-mode your goal and it will invoke the correct workflow for the task.
sents.zh: 告诉 poteto-mode 你的目标，它将为该任务调用正确的工作流。

sents.en: It keeps your code concise, simple and verified.
sents.zh: 它能让你的代码保持简洁、简单且经过验证。

paragraphs.en: For concurrency bugs and invariants that tests cannot reach, /create-formal-verification-skill picks the riskiest property in your code, verifies it with a tool that fits, and leaves a project skill the next agent reruns. The separate agent-formal-verify plugin goes deeper on the method, with guided TLA+ model checking, Lean proofs, and Kani for Rust.
paragraphs.zh: 对于测试无法覆盖的并发缺陷与不变式，/create-formal-verification-skill 会挑选你代码中风险最高的属性，用合适的工具加以验证，并留下一个可供下一个智能体重跑的项目技能。 独立的 agent-formal-verify 插件更深入地探讨该方法，提供引导式的 TLA+ 模型检查、Lean 证明，以及面向 Rust 的 Kani。

sents.en: For concurrency bugs and invariants that tests cannot reach, /create-formal-verification-skill picks the riskiest property in your code, verifies it with a tool that fits, and leaves a project skill the next agent reruns.
sents.zh: 对于测试无法覆盖的并发缺陷与不变式，/create-formal-verification-skill 会挑选你代码中风险最高的属性，用合适的工具加以验证，并留下一个可供下一个智能体重跑的项目技能。

sents.zh: 独立的 agent-formal-verify 插件更深入地探讨该方法，提供引导式的 TLA+ 模型检查、Lean 证明，以及面向 Rust 的 Kani。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude /plugin install pstack@pstack-claude
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude /plugin install pstack@pstack-claude

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude codex plugin add pstack@pstack-claude Pi Run in your terminal:
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude codex plugin add pstack@pstack-claude Pi 在你的终端中运行：

paragraphs.en: pi install git:github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude The package loads the skills and the pstack Pi extension, which adds the subagent, question, and wake-up tools the skills use, plus /loop and the routing instruction. Invoke a skill with /skill:<name> .
paragraphs.zh: pi install git:github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude 该软件包会加载各项技能以及 pstack Pi 扩展，该扩展提供了这些技能所使用的 subagent（子智能体）、question（提问）和 wake-up（唤醒）工具，另外还包含 /loop 命令和路由指令。 使用 /skill:<name> 调用某个技能。

sents.en: Invoke a skill with /skill:<name> .
sents.zh: 使用 /skill:<name> 调用某个技能。

paragraphs.en: copilot plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude copilot plugin install pstack@pstack-claude This installs pstack for the Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app, which share ~/.copilot . Start a new session afterwards. Copilot ships no default pstack models, so the first skill that needs one runs setup-pstack to pick from the models your account lists, and later sessions reuse that choice.
paragraphs.zh: copilot plugin marketplace add michael-denyer/pstack-claude copilot plugin install pstack@pstack-claude 此命令为 Copilot CLI 和 GitHub Copilot 应用安装 pstack，二者共用 ~/.copilot 。 之后请启动一个新的会话。 Copilot 不提供默认的 pstack 模型，因此第一个需要模型的技能会运行 setup-pstack，从你的账户所列出的模型中进行选择，后续会话将复用该选择。

paragraphs.en: The Copilot build is tested on Copilot CLI 1.0.87 through 1.0.92. On those versions the routing hook's context reaches the session alongside other plugins' session-start context. If a later version keeps only one plugin's context, setup-pstack offers a standing instruction for ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md instead. On 1.0.92, once the CLI caches its computer-use experiment assignment, copilot -p sessions list no plugin skills and a skill call returns "Skill not found". Interactive sessions, the hooks, and the agents are unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: Copilot 构建版本在 Copilot CLI 1.0.87 至 1.0.92 上进行了测试。 在这些版本上，路由钩子的上下文会与其他插件的会话启动上下文一起到达会话。 如果后续版本只保留某一个插件的上下文，setup-pstack 则改为在 ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md 中提供一条固定指令。 在 1.0.92 上，一旦 CLI 缓存其 computer-use 实验分配，copilot -p 会话就不会列出任何插件技能，且技能调用会返回 "Skill not found"。 交互式会话、钩子以及智能体均不受影响。

sents.zh: Copilot 构建版本在 Copilot CLI 1.0.87 至 1.0.92 上进行了测试。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude muse plugins install ./plugins/pstack muse plugins approve pstack The first command installs the native Muse plugin bundle. The second approves its SessionStart hook and agent definitions, which Muse runs only after approval. Start a new session afterwards. Invoke a skill with /<name> (for example /poteto-mode ), which Muse lists for each user-invocable skill.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude muse plugins install ./plugins/pstack muse plugins approve pstack 第一条命令安装原生 Muse 插件包。 第二条命令批准其 SessionStart 钩子和智能体定义，Muse 只有在批准之后才会运行它们。 之后启动一个新会话。 使用 /<name>（例如 /poteto-mode）调用技能，Muse 会为每个可供用户调用的技能列出对应名称。

sents.en: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude muse plugins install ./plugins/pstack muse plugins approve pstack The first command installs the native Muse plugin bundle.
sents.zh: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude muse plugins install ./plugins/pstack muse plugins approve pstack 第一条命令安装原生 Muse 插件包。

sents.en: The second approves its SessionStart hook and agent definitions, which Muse runs only after approval.
sents.zh: 第二条命令批准其 SessionStart 钩子和智能体定义，Muse 只有在批准之后才会运行它们。

sents.en: Start a new session afterwards.
sents.zh: 之后启动一个新会话。

sents.en: Invoke a skill with /<name> (for example /poteto-mode ), which Muse lists for each user-invocable skill.

paragraphs.en: OpenCode (the CLI and the desktop app), Gemini CLI, Prime Agent, and skills-only Codex installs read skills from ~/.agents/skills/ . Run in your terminal:
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode（CLI 和桌面应用）、Gemini CLI、Prime Agent 以及仅安装技能的 Codex，会从 ~/.agents/skills/ 目录读取技能。请在你的终端中运行：

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude mkdir -p ~ /.agents/skills for s in plugins/pstack/skills/ * / ; do target= ~ /.agents/skills/ " $( basename " $s " ) " test -e " $target " || test -L " $target " || ln -s " $( pwd ) / $s " " $target " done To update, run git pull in the clone, then run the for loop again to link skills added since the last run. These installs have no routing hook, so ask for poteto-mode by name or add a standing instruction to the harness's instruction file. See shared installation for per-harness notes and uninstalling.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude mkdir -p ~ /.agents/skills for s in plugins/pstack/skills/ * / ; do target= ~ /.agents/skills/ " $( basename " $s " ) " test -e " $target " || test -L " $target " || ln -s " $( pwd ) / $s " " $target " done 若要更新，请在克隆目录中运行 git pull，然后再次运行上述 for 循环，以链接自上次运行以来新增的技能。 这些安装方式没有路由钩子，因此请按名称请求 poteto-mode，或在 harness 的指令文件中添加一条长期有效的指令。 有关各 harness 的注意事项及卸载方法，请参阅共享安装说明。

sents.zh: git clone https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude cd pstack-claude mkdir -p ~ /.agents/skills for s in plugins/pstack/skills/ * / ; do target= ~ /.agents/skills/ " $( basename " $s " ) " test -e " $target " || test -L " $target " || ln -s " $( pwd ) / $s " " $target " done 若要更新，请在克隆目录中运行 git pull，然后再次运行上述 for 循环，以链接自上次运行以来新增的技能。

paragraphs.en: pstack routes tasks to poteto-mode automatically. At session start, a hook injects an instruction that points the agent at it: the plugin's hook on Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Muse, and the pstack extension on Pi. Codex runs the hook only after you trust it through /hooks , and Muse only after muse plugins approve pstack . Other harnesses have no hook.
paragraphs.zh: pstack 会自动将任务路由到 poteto-mode。 在会话开始时，一个钩子会注入一条指令，将智能体指向它：在 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot 和 Muse 上是该插件的钩子，在 Pi 上则是 pstack 扩展。 Codex 只有在你通过 /hooks 信任它之后才会运行该钩子，Muse 只有在 muse plugins 批准 pstack 之后才会运行。 其他宿主环境没有钩子。

sents.en: pstack routes tasks to poteto-mode automatically.
sents.zh: pstack 会自动将任务路由到 poteto-mode。

paragraphs.en: Run setup-pstack to turn automatic routing on or off, change model defaults, or set a reasoning effort per role ( arena runners: opus @xhigh, fable @max ).
paragraphs.zh: 运行 setup-pstack 可开启或关闭自动路由、更改模型默认设置，或按角色设置推理力度（arena runners: opus @xhigh, fable @max）。

paragraphs.en: Use poteto-mode to fix the search filter resetting when I change pages. For a bug, it reproduces the failure, uses how and why to investigate, delegates the fix, then reruns the failing case. If the fix crosses a function boundary, it brings in architect before implementation. You receive the fix and the failing and passing evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 poteto-mode 来修复“改变页面时搜索过滤器被重置”的问题。 对于一个 bug，它会复现失败，使用 how 和 why 进行调查，委派修复，然后重新运行失败用例。 如果修复跨越函数边界，它会在实现前引入 architect 智能体。 你会收到修复内容以及失败和通过的验证证据。

paragraphs.en: Other playbooks cover planning, features, refactoring, performance issues, investigations, prototypes, PR maintenance, shipping, and longer projects.
paragraphs.zh: 其他指南手册涵盖规划、功能开发、重构、性能问题、调查分析、原型设计、PR 维护、发布上线以及更长期的项目。

paragraphs.en: pstack has no server or telemetry. Anything its skills ask your agent to read, including session transcripts, goes to your model provider. Scripts run locally, and PR tools use your GitHub CLI login.
paragraphs.zh: pstack 没有服务器，也没有遥测功能。 其技能要求你的智能体读取的任何内容，包括会话记录，都会发送到你的模型提供商。 脚本在本地运行，PR 工具使用你的 GitHub CLI 登录。
